items.title: 亲测为实：难以置信的推理速度
items.summary: Kog团队在标准数据中心GPU上实现了极高的单用户推理速度，在8× AMD MI300X GPUs上达到3，000 tokens/s，在8× NVIDIA H200上达到2，100 tokens/s。相比常规推理速度（约100-300 tokens/s），实现了10-30倍提升。其核心思路是将LLM解码视为内存流问题，通过协同设计monokernel、重建同步机制、针对性内存访问映射及采用延迟张量并行的Laneformer模型架构，消除了传统流程的阻塞点。

zh.lead: 大家都在看那条关于人们把 AI 当成社交挡箭牌的 897 条评论长帖。更可卖给 builder 的信号更小，也更扎： Recurflux 说，仪表盘会显示 MRR，却不会显示失败付款造成的漏损；而 Reconcra 是一位有 20 年银行经验的人用 7 天做出来的，用来审计 Shopify 和 Stripe。

build.title: Failed-Payment Leak Receipt
build.oneLiner: 面向小型 SaaS 和电商创始人的 Stripe / Shopify 收入审计：指出本周哪些失败扣款、续费漏收、退款和打款不匹配正在悄悄抽走现金。这个方向由 Recurflux、Reconcra、一条 $900 到 $2,100 MRR 的增长故事，以及一篇 $1,078 广告费复盘共同支撑。

signals: AI 反弹已经变成普通用户的行为信号：I'm Tired of Talking to AI 引发 897 条讨论，DuckDuckGo search saw 28% more visits after Google said people love AI mode 引发 334 条讨论，YouTube to automatically label AI-generated videos 引发 319 条讨论。
创始人仪表盘暴露的是漏钱点，而不只是增长捷报：Recurflux 盯失败付款，Reconcra 审计 Shopify / Stripe，Reddit 出现 $900 到 $2,100 MRR 的 28 天增长，另一个创始人在花掉 $1,078 广告费、获得 226 个用户后关停。
工具所有权正在从 AI 扩展到更广的领域：Last.fm is now independent 引发 175 条讨论，Posthorn 把自托管邮件带到 Show HN，意思是软件运行在你自己的服务器上；Open-source Workspace 则打包了邮件、文档、表格和网盘。

en.lead: Everyone is reading the 897-comment thread about people using AI as a social shield. The more sellable builder signal is smaller and meaner: Recurflux says dashboards show MRR but not failed-payment leakage, while Reconcra was built by a 20-year banking veteran in 7 days to audit Shopify and Stripe.

build.title: Failed-Payment Leak Receipt
build.oneLiner: a Stripe and Shopify revenue audit for small SaaS and commerce founders that shows which failed charges, renewal misses, refunds, and payout mismatches are silently draining cash this week, backed by Recurflux, Reconcra, a $900 to $2,100 MRR growth story, and a $1,078 ads postmortem.

signals: AI backlash became a normal-user behavior signal: I'm Tired of Talking to AI drew 897 comments, DuckDuckGo search saw 28% more visits after Google said people love AI mode drew 334, and YouTube to automatically label AI-generated videos drew 319.

Founder dashboards are exposing money leaks, not just growth wins: Recurflux targets failed payments, Reconcra audits Shopify/Stripe, Reddit showed $900 to $2,100 MRR in 28 days, and another founder shut down after $1,078 in ads and 226 users.

Tool ownership is broadening beyond AI: Last.fm is now independent drew 175 comments, Posthorn brought self-hosted email, meaning software run on your own server, to Show HN, and Open-source Workspace packaged mail, docs, spreadsheets, and drive.
